tools.name: launch_cloud_training_run
tools.description: Rents a GPU instance from the cloud provider for a training run, which charges the account for the reserved hours. It records the run in the experiment database and posts a notification to the team Slack webhook.

params.name: experiment_id
params.description: ID of the experiment the run belongs to

params.name: instance_type
params.description: GPU instance type to rent, e.g. p4d.24xlarge

params.name: hours
params.description: Number of hours to reserve the instance

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import boto3
import requests
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TRACKING_DB", "experiments.db")
SLACK_WEBHOOK = os.environ["SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"]
ec2 = boto3.client("ec2", region_name="us-east-1")


@function_tool
def launch_cloud_training_run(experiment_id: str, instance_type: str, hours: int) -> str:
    if hours <= 0:
        return "hours must be positive"
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT image_id FROM experiments WHERE id = ?", (experiment_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                return f"Experiment {experiment_id} not found"
            resp = ec2.run_instances(
                ImageId=row[0],
                InstanceType=instance_type,
                MinCount=1,
                MaxCount=1,
                TagSpecifications=[
                    {
                        "ResourceType": "instance",
                        "Tags": [{"Key": "experiment", "Value": experiment_id}],
                    }
                ],
            )
            instance_id = resp["Instances"][0]["InstanceId"]
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO runs (experiment_id, instance_id, instance_type, hours, status) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'provisioning')",
                (experiment_id, instance_id, instance_type, hours),
            )
    requests.post(
        SLACK_WEBHOOK,
        json={"text": f"Run launched for {experiment_id} on {instance_type} ({instance_id}) for {hours}h"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return f"Launched {instance_id} for experiment {experiment_id}"

tools.name: archive_and_evaluate_checkpoint
tools.description: Moves a model checkpoint file from the run's working directory into the archive folder, then runs the evaluation script on it in its new location. Returns the script's output.

params.name: checkpoint_path
params.description: Path to the checkpoint file to archive

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Destination directory for the archived checkpoint

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool


def _move_checkpoint(src: Path, dest_dir: Path) -> Path:
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return Path(shutil.move(str(src), str(dest_dir / src.name)))


@function_tool
def archive_and_evaluate_checkpoint(checkpoint_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(checkpoint_path)
    if not src.is_file():
        return f"Checkpoint not found: {checkpoint_path}"
    new_path = _move_checkpoint(src, Path(archive_dir))
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "evaluate.py", "--checkpoint", str(new_path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=1800,
    )
    return f"Moved to {new_path}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}"

tools.name: buy_compute_credits_for_team
tools.description: Purchases prepaid compute credits by charging the team's saved card, and grants the team's members permission to launch runs against the new credit pool.

params.name: team_id
params.description: ID of the team receiving the credits

params.name: amount_usd
params.description: Dollar amount of credits to purchase

params.name: member_emails
params.description: Emails of members who may launch runs with these credits

import os

import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
TRACKER_URL = os.environ.get("TRACKER_URL", "http://tracker.internal")
TRACKER_TOKEN = os.environ["TRACKER_TOKEN"]


def _grant_launch_access(team_id: str, email: str) -> int:
    resp = requests.put(
        f"{TRACKER_URL}/api/teams/{team_id}/credit-pool/members",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TRACKER_TOKEN}"},
        json={"email": email, "role": "launcher"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return resp.status_code


@function_tool
def buy_compute_credits_for_team(team_id: str, amount_usd: int, member_emails: list[str]) -> str:
    if amount_usd <= 0 or amount_usd > 5000:
        return "amount_usd must be between 1 and 5000"
    customer = requests.get(
        f"{TRACKER_URL}/api/teams/{team_id}",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TRACKER_TOKEN}"},
        timeout=10,
    ).json()
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_usd * 100,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer["stripe_customer_id"],
        payment_method=customer["default_payment_method"],
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Compute credits for team {team_id}",
    )
    failed = []
    for email in member_emails:
        if _grant_launch_access(team_id, email) >= 300:
            failed.append(email)
    return f"Charged ${amount_usd} ({charge.id}); access failed for: {failed or 'none'}"
